race.comment: Open race to close out the card. RAIN QUEEN (13) gave a sight here last time, leading until late before finishing fourth and beaten 0.9 lengths over 1200m. Maps nicely for this from gate six and will take some catching. BLACK ADAM (4) was handy on straightening and went on to finish second last start over 1200m at this circuit, beaten half a length as favourite. Alice Kennedy gets the best out of this six-year-old gelding. Well placed and there is no reason why he cannot take this out. OZZY THE EQUALISER (10) got the job done here last time out and will have taken some confidence from that victory. In the mix. LORD OF VALOUR (2) next best with the claim.
